Ledger confirmed that a device sold by one of its Southeast Asian resellers contained a hidden hardware implant, and investigators estimate the related losses at over $86 million. Ledger says its own systems weren’t compromised and the case appears limited to that one reseller. Swipe to see what happened and what to do if you bought from them.
